content.text: One thread still depends on `git check-ignore` semantics, so I’m verifying the CLI behavior locally before I call that one stale or valid.

I checked PR #890 against the current branch state. Two comments are still relevant, and one is still technically relevant but low priority.

- Medium: [`cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/temporary.go:1113`](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/temporary.go#L1113) still calls `git check-ignore -z --stdin` without `--no-index`. `git check-ignore` ignores tracked files by default, so a force-added file that still matches `.gitignore` would not be filtered. The Cursor comment about tracked ignored files is still valid.
- Low: [`cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/temporary.go:1105`](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/temporary.go#L1105) still returns `files` if `repo.Worktree()` fails, even though the doc comment says failures “fail closed (returns nil)”. The original Copilot comment was about comment/behavior mismatch; that mismatch still exists on this path.
- Low: [`cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/checkpoint_test.go:1848`](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/checkpoint_test.go#L1848), [`cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/checkpoint_test.go:1980`](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/checkpoint_test.go#L1980), [`cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/checkpoint_test.go:2095`](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/checkpoint_test.go#L2095) still use `git.PlainInit` rather than the repo’s `testutil.InitRepo` pattern. That review comment is still true, although this file already has older tests using the same pattern, so it’s more consistency/hardening than a PR-specific regression.

The rest look stale and can be resolved:

- The exit-code handling complaint is fixed at [`temporary.go:1118`](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/temporary.go#L1118): exit code `1` returns `files`, other failures warn and return `nil`.
- The bad `--no-index` comment was removed.
- The noisy/sensitive per-file logging is fixed; it now logs only a debug count at [`temporary.go:1151`](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/temporary.go#L1151).
- The broken doc-comment split is fixed; the function comments are clean again.
- The fallback-to-go-git-ignore suggestion is optional, not something still unaddressed in the current implementation.

If you want, I can fix the still-relevant ones and leave the PR in a state where those threads can be resolved.
